text: Herbalife Ltd.'s 2026 proxy statement lists six owners of more than 5% of its common shares: The Vanguard Group (12.08%), Nantahala Capital Management (8.40%), The Baupost Group (8.33%), Route One Investment Company (7.28%), BlackRock (7.16%) and Renaissance Technologies (5.43%).
